result.summary:
Repaired the seven refuter-confirmed issues in the FZ v3 close-out documents. Each fix was checked against its source file before editing; no study folder, ledger, data, harness, oos_once.py, strategies/, fz.py, engine.py or tests/ file was touched (git status shows only the three modified docs plus the untracked REPORT.md).

1. REPORT.md §1 (lines 23-30): the false universal "Every kept book of every study stays negative at 5 and at 8 pts" is replaced with the 8-pt statement (operating_point_sizing §0: 0 of 326; online_learner §0: 0 of 468 per timeframe; phase-3 finalists' slip8 books -1,378 / -1,396 / -1,089, -971, -278 / -499) and the honest 5-pt exceptions: the 68-103-trade 1 min online-learner paths (best +112.36, `19f7ff81224bafa0`, kept 68 of 4,452, fails kept share, kept n, control 0.1, blocks 2/12; online_learner §0, §2) and the H1 L0 robustness rows (5 min take_only `2ad039c7d19cf22d` +126.30, take_or_reenter `5d3759e3d6038faa` +133.81, ctrl 28.9 / 31.4; h1_gate_audit §3). Covers refuter items 1 and 6.
2. REPORT.md §1 table, volume row: "5 min +0.09 to +0.20 vs +0.01" -> "+0.04 to +0.20 vs +0.01 across the six v x N cells; the v=2 / N=20 cell alone is +0.09" (h2_h3_h4 §2.2 cells 0.092, 0.055, 0.127, 0.035, 0.197, 0.136 vs 0.008).
3. FZ.md §20: "0 of 18 real gates" -> "0 of 18 reference-gate × generator cells (3 gates, 3 generators, 2 timeframes)" (null_tapes_drift §4 table, §4a "0 of 18").
4. REPORT.md §2.2 heading and the ctrl/perm row: now states the IS rows reproduce pre_registration.json on every non-Monte-Carlo statistic while the control percentile and permutation p are re-drawn (oos.json 62.3 / 0.845 and 14.3 / 0.242 vs pre_registration.json rows `f8ea66553101dc24` / `60662a5e5ab612f8`: 62.6 / 0.847 and 13.6 / 0.236; verified by reading both JSON files' key values only).
5. Ledger-id consistency for the hgbc frozen form: S49 Impact (8) now cites the finalist's frozen form `afd754b8cc67c0d6` (gate_family §4 line 324) and names the rule-list form `f773bc09dbf984b2` as carrying the same numbers; REPORT.md §4.8 names both ids with their controls (57.9 / 56.4, gate_family distillation table lines 211-212).
6. REPORT.md §1 table, "a learned rule" row: "0 of 16 + 32 LLM rules" (1 min) and "0 of 32" (5 min) -> "0 of 8 + 16 LLM rules (round 0 + round 1, per timeframe)" in both columns (llm_hypotheses §3: 8 rules per timeframe; llm_round1 §0/§8: 8 rules per half per timeframe).

No verdict changes anywhere; every study remains null. The README sentence needed no change (nothing flagged and no corrected claim appears in it). Files changed: /home/user/money-maker/research/strategy_lab/fz_v3/out/REPORT.md, /home/user/money-maker/docs/STRATEGY_ANALYSIS_TODO.md (S49 Impact item 8), /home/user/money-maker/research/strategy_lab/FZ.md (§20).
